FX-BRICON-001.says: Brightness 0 and contrast 0, the settings as they start: the drawing, untouched.

FX-BRICON-002.says: Brightness 50: every channel of every shown pixel is lifted 50 levels of 255 as it is written: black turns #323232, the grey #b2b2b2; the white, already full, is held there and stays white, and the skin's red and green are held at full while its blue rises to 240.

FX-BRICON-003.says: Brightness -50: every channel lowered 50 levels: white turns #cdcdcd, the grey #4e4e4e; black, and the line's channels, all below 50, are held at 0, so both turn black.

FX-BRICON-004.says: Brightness 150, the most: black turns #969696, and every channel at or above 105 goes to full, so the grey, the light grey, the skin, the shaded skin and the pink all turn white; the blue keeps a little of its red (58 + 150 = 208).

FX-BRICON-005.says: Brightness -150, the least: white turns #696969 (105), and every channel at or below 150 goes to 0, so the tones up to the grey turn black and the red keeps only some of its red (214 - 150 = 64).

FX-BRICON-006.says: Contrast 50: the tones pushed apart from half by 1 / 0.505, about 1.98: the dark grey darkens, the light grey lightens, the grey, a hair above half, moves a hair up, black and white stay, and the colours grow stronger.

FX-BRICON-007.says: Contrast -50: the tones drawn half way to half brightness: black turns #404040 but for rounding (63.75), white #bfbfbf (191.25), and the colours grow duller.

FX-BRICON-008.says: Contrast -100, the least: every shown pixel, whatever its colour, turns flat mid grey, #808080 but for rounding (127.5), at its own covering.

FX-BRICON-009.says: Contrast 100, the most: the tones pushed apart 100 times: every channel below half goes to 0 and every one above to full, so the colours turn the pure colours they lean to, the blue #0000ff and the skin #ffffff; only the grey, half a level above half, stays between, at 0.5 + 0.5 / 255 * 100 = 0.696.

FX-BRICON-010.says: Brightness 30 and contrast 40: contrast first, about half, then brightness added: the grey turns 0.5 + (0.5 / 255) / 0.604 + 30 / 255 of its scale.

FX-BRICON-011.says: Brightness -100 and contrast -100: every shown pixel turns the one flat dark grey 0.5 - 100 / 255 of the scale (27.5 levels).

FX-BRICON-012.says: Brightness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 FX-BRICON-002 (brightness 50), frame 4 brightness 100.

FX-BRICON-013.says: Contrast keyed from -100 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: frame 0 FX-BRICON-008, frame 2, both at 0, the drawing untouched, frame 4 FX-BRICON-009.

FX-BRICON-014.says: Brightness eased from 0 at frame 0 to 150 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it has gone past 150 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-BRICON-004.

FX-BRICON-015.says: Brightness held at 50 from frame 0 and keyed to -50 at frame 3: frames 0 and 2 are FX-BRICON-002, frame 4 FX-BRICON-003.

FX-BRICON-016.says: FX-BRICON-010 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-BRICON-017.says: Brightness 151, above 150. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BRICON-018.says: Brightness -151, below -150. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BRICON-019.says: Contrast 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BRICON-020.says: Contrast -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BRICON-021.says: Contrast keyed to 120 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BRICON-022.says: Brightness keyed from -160 at frame 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
